The '''Astal sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], situated near [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Astal included [[Eredin]], [[Jarvanam]], and [[Skann]].
